nodes.doc: Put the target into the goal container as one recorded episode: unclutch, record, locate the target, [hold for the camera transition], pick (PickRecovery on a failure), place, go home, judge, save or drop.
nodes.name: PickAndPlace

nodes.doc: Pick the target up from above (cube_pose): approach 10 cm over it, grasp 1 cm above its centre, close, lift 20 cm, and fail (NoGrasp) unless the fingers hold it.
nodes.name: Pick

nodes.doc: A failed Pick's recovery (the paper's Fig. 3): measure the target again, open, and turn the grasp 90 deg about z to try the other pair of faces; its parent then resumes at Pick.
nodes.name: PickRecovery

nodes.doc: Drop what is held into the goal container (goal): 15 cm over its centre, straight down, minimal wrist turn, then open.
nodes.name: Place

nodes.doc: Place what is held on a support (support): announce the subtask (place), carry it over, release it.
nodes.name: PlaceOn

nodes.doc: Go back to the rest pose and stay still for 1 s, the stationary end of going home.
nodes.name: Return

nodes.doc: Free the arm and open the hand at rest: to the rest pose, 10 cm down (which moves the arm even if it already was at rest), open.
nodes.name: Unclutch

nodes.doc: Carry what is held (top) over the support: measure the support now (it may have been nudged), go 10 cm over where the cube will rest, and fail (DroppedInTransit) unless it is still in the fingers. A failed move detours through the home joints first.
nodes.name: CarryToSupport

nodes.doc: The target's pose as a top-down grasp (cube_pose): measured, its tilt dropped, its yaw reduced by the cube's 4 identical sides, the gripper turned to face down.
nodes.name: GetTargetPose

nodes.doc: Set what is held down on the support and let go: lower slowly to the release height (0.0665 m over the support's centre: a 0.0515 m cube edge, the 0.01 m grasp height and a 5 mm drop), open, and rise slowly straight up so the fingers do not drag it along. Failed moves detour through home.
nodes.name: Release

nodes.doc: Pick's fallback when the straight lift cannot run: up through the (high) rest pose instead, then resume at the grasp check, so the arm never sweeps across at grasp height.
nodes.name: RetreatViaRest

nodes.doc: Ask the scene whether the task is done: task_success (StopEpisode saves on it) and task_reason.
nodes.name: CheckSuccess

nodes.doc: Close onto a ~5 cm cube: 0.01 m per finger lies past its faces, so the stalled fingers keep squeezing (the gripper controller holds the stalled position; a target at the faces held no force).
nodes.name: CloseGripper

nodes.doc: Retrieves the current pose of the specified primitive in the robot's frame_id (Ruling 4: its base link; GUIDE converts from the scene).
nodes.name: GetPrimPose

nodes.doc: Retrieves the current poses of several primitives, in the given order, each in the robot's frame_id (GetPrimPose's).
nodes.name: GetPrimPoses

nodes.doc: Checks whether two primitives are clashing (the simulator compares their bounding boxes).
nodes.name: IsPrimClashing

nodes.doc: Asks the scene whether its success criterion holds right now.
nodes.name: IsTaskSuccessful

nodes.doc: Move the arm to its home joints (${robot.home}): the one well-posed start for a 7-DoF arm, which a Cartesian move keeps in whatever posture it is in and a pose goal may leave in any.
nodes.name: MoveHome

nodes.doc: Executes a Cartesian move to the specified target pose at the given speed.
nodes.name: MoveToCartesianPose

nodes.doc: Executes a joint move to the specified target configuration at the given speed.
nodes.name: MoveToJointConfiguration

nodes.doc: Sends one Cartesian velocity command; the node neither times nor stops it.
nodes.name: MoveWithCartesianVelocity

nodes.doc: Open the gripper fully: 0.04 m per finger, the Franka hand's (FR3 and Panda) widest.
nodes.name: OpenGripper

nodes.doc: Executes a gripper control action to the specified target position.
nodes.name: SetGripperState

nodes.doc: Hold the arm still while dataset.camera_transition moves the cameras onto their mounts; only with the transition on (${episode.camera_hold}), for its duration plus one frame period (${episode.hold_seconds}).
nodes.name: CameraHold

nodes.doc: How many of `poses`, from the first, follow one another at a fixed offset.
nodes.name: ChainLength

nodes.doc: ``items[index + shift]``: pick from a list by an index another node computed.
nodes.name: GetItem

nodes.doc: Inverts the given pose or transform.
nodes.name: InvertPose

nodes.doc: Pauses the recording; the episode stays open and StartRecording resumes it.
nodes.name: PauseRecording

nodes.doc: Project an object's full 3D orientation onto the pure Z-rotation of the base frame, assuming the object is meant to be reached from straight above.
nodes.name: ProjectRotationToBaseZ

nodes.doc: Collapse a Z rotation to the smallest-magnitude equivalent one under an assumed n-fold polygonal symmetry.
nodes.name: ReduceRotationToSymmetry

nodes.doc: Tells the scene what the robot works on from now on, at the GUIDE-EX layers.
nodes.name: SetPrompt

nodes.doc: Start recording the episode into dataset_path (a busy recorder has held start_recording for ~3 min).
nodes.name: StartEpisode

nodes.doc: Starts recording a LeRobot episode in the scene, or resumes a paused one.
nodes.name: StartRecording

nodes.doc: Stop recording: save the episode if task_success, else discard it (saving encodes every camera first).
nodes.name: StopEpisode

nodes.doc: Stops recording and saves or discards the episode.
nodes.name: StopRecording

nodes.doc: Composes two poses or transforms: ``l_pose * r_pose``.
nodes.name: TransformPose

nodes.doc: Executes a wait action for the specified number of seconds.
nodes.name: WaitForSeconds
